source: Fixed-factor sweep on Si2, MgO, MgO(O_h), LiF, Al (FD 0.1 eV) and Ni (spin, FD 0.1 eV) against the same-system 16xENCUT sparsity-off reference; gates: 1 meV/atom energy, 1e-3 eV/A force, 0.01 GPa stress, 5 meV band window. Hold-out: Si8, Al(001) slab, Si64, Ni4 (Ni_pv). Vacuum cells keep padding 2 because the Al(001) slab fails the force gate with f6 and padding 1 together (1.98e-3 eV/A) while f6 (3.0e-4) and padding 1 (4.5e-5) each pass.

density_cutoff.evidence: largest passing weighted L2 tail 4.25e-7 (MgO f6); smallest failing 8.77e-7 (LiF f8); budget at 0.6x the largest pass

stricter_when.evidence: Al (no d moment, tiny compensation tail) used 0.99 of the stress gate at f4 and 0.30 at f6; the smooth density/Fermi-surface response, not the PAW tail, limits metals

xc_padding.evidence: Al(001) slab, vacuum 0.60: auto f6 + padding 1 gave force error 1.98e-3 eV/A (gate 1e-3); f6 with padding 2 gave 3.0e-4. GGA terms in low-density vacuum alias on the reduced XC grid.
padding 1 changed E by <=0.0008 meV/atom and stress by <=0.0001 GPa on all six fit systems

eigen_search_factor.evidence: Al: factor 1e-2..1e-4 doubled outer iterations (10 -> 19-22), 1e-5 gave 12
best or near-best wall time on Si2, MgO_h, Ni; result unchanged (certificate)

block_ortho.evidence: identical results, fewer S applications on all systems

paw_compensation.evidence: identical energies/forces/stress to full on all fit systems; certificate residual unchanged
